tokens.name: background
tokens.usage: The inset main panel: the page every view sits on.

tokens.name: foreground
tokens.usage: Primary text and icons on every surface (13:1 or more in both themes).

tokens.name: card
tokens.usage: Cards and the table container. One step above background in dark.

tokens.name: card-foreground
tokens.usage: Text on card.

tokens.name: popover
tokens.usage: Menus, the command palette, dialogs, sheets, toasts. The highest surface in dark.

tokens.name: popover-foreground
tokens.usage: Text on popover.

tokens.name: muted
tokens.usage: Quiet fills: kbd, code, read-only inputs, skeletons, the segmented tab list, neutral badges.

tokens.name: muted-foreground
tokens.usage: Secondary text: descriptions, hints, dates, column headers, the currency code beside an amount. 5:1 or more on every surface in both themes.

tokens.name: accent
tokens.usage: Hover of rows, menu items, ghost and outline buttons; the active command item.

tokens.name: accent-foreground
tokens.usage: Text on accent.

tokens.name: secondary
tokens.usage: Secondary buttons, status badge ground.

tokens.name: secondary-foreground
tokens.usage: Text on secondary.

tokens.name: border
tokens.usage: Hairlines: cards, tables, separators, the inset panel edge. Alpha white in dark so it reads on every surface.

tokens.name: input
tokens.usage: Borders of inputs, selects, checkboxes, outline buttons. Light like shadcn's (1.5:1); controls also carry shadow-xs and a placeholder, and focus adds a solid ring. Use the High-contrast note in the README where 3:1 edges are required.

tokens.name: app-accent
tokens.usage: The accent of the app on screen. This value is the neutral default (zinc-900 / zinc-50) used outside any app: the shell frame, Home, the command palette. Inside an element with data-app="<code>", bundle.css points it at app-<code>.

tokens.name: app-accent-foreground
tokens.usage: Text and icons on an app-accent fill: white in light, ink in dark. 5.5:1 or more for every app.

tokens.name: app-accent-soft
tokens.usage: The faint fill of the app on screen: the active nav item, the selected row, the active saved view, link chips. Neutral default outside an app; inside data-app it becomes app-<code>-soft.

tokens.name: primary
tokens.usage: The one main action of a view, checked checkboxes and switches, the bulk bar. Follows the app accent.

tokens.name: primary-foreground
tokens.usage: Text on primary.

tokens.name: brand
tokens.usage: The suite blue. Only the info status, chart-1 and focus outside an app. Inside an app, links and focus follow app-accent.

tokens.name: brand-foreground
tokens.usage: Text on a brand fill (5.2:1 light, 6.9:1 dark).

tokens.name: selection
tokens.usage: Selected rows and the active facet value. Follows the app accent.

tokens.name: ring
tokens.usage: The 2px focus outline outside an app. Inside data-app, bundle.css sets it to app-accent.

tokens.name: ring-halo
tokens.usage: The soft 3px halo around a focused input.

tokens.name: success
tokens.usage: Text and icon of paid, succeeded, active, enabled; positive deltas. 4.9:1 on success-soft.

tokens.name: success-soft
tokens.usage: The pill ground of a success StatusBadge.

tokens.name: warning
tokens.usage: Text and icon of past due, pending, retrying, expiring. 5:1 on warning-soft.

tokens.name: warning-soft
tokens.usage: The pill ground of a warning StatusBadge.

tokens.name: destructive
tokens.usage: Text and icon of failed, revoked, dead, uncollectible; destructive buttons; field errors; negative amounts. 5.3:1 on destructive-soft.

tokens.name: destructive-soft
tokens.usage: The pill ground of a danger StatusBadge; the hover of a danger ghost button.

tokens.name: destructive-foreground
tokens.usage: Label on a destructive button.

tokens.name: info
tokens.usage: Text and icon of open, running, trialing. 5:1 on info-soft.

tokens.name: info-soft
tokens.usage: The pill ground of an info StatusBadge.

tokens.name: neutral-soft
tokens.usage: The pill ground of a neutral StatusBadge (draft, void, canceled); its text is muted-foreground.

tokens.name: overlay
tokens.usage: Scrim behind dialogs, sheets, the bottom sheet, the nav drawer and the command palette.

tokens.name: sidebar

tokens.name: sidebar-foreground

tokens.name: scope-platform

groups.name: Headings

styles.name: text-metric
styles.usage: The key figure of a record: the amount atop a Sheet, the value of a Stat.

styles.name: text-title
styles.usage: The page title, once per page. 22/28 on phones.

styles.name: text-figure
styles.usage: The count in a saved-view tile; tabular figures.

styles.name: text-heading
styles.usage: Card, sheet section and dialog titles.

groups.name: Text
groups.note: 14px body. Inter carries Vietnamese; tabular figures in tables.

styles.usage: UI text, table cells, menu items.

styles.name: text-body-strong
styles.usage: Buttons, labels, the main line of a cell or card row.

styles.name: text-caption
styles.usage: Badges, kbd, column headers, sidebar group labels.

groups.name: Code
groups.note: Only for things typed or pasted as code. IDs stay in Inter.

styles.name: text-code
styles.usage: Permission codes, scopes, request syntax, keys.

tokens.name: space-1_5

tokens.name: space-2

tokens.name: space-3
tokens.usage: Cell padding; stacked text blocks.

tokens.name: space-4
tokens.usage: Between cards and fields; card header to body.

tokens.name: space-5
tokens.usage: Card padding.

tokens.name: space-6
tokens.usage: Page padding; between page sections.

tokens.name: space-8
tokens.usage: Page padding (comfortable, desktop).

tokens.name: space-10
tokens.usage: Around empty states.

radius.note: Softer than v3: 8px controls, 10px containers, 14px overlays.

tokens.usage: Checkboxes, kbd, code.

tokens.name: radius-md
tokens.usage: Buttons, inputs, menu items, tab triggers, status pills, the small AppMark.

tokens.name: radius-lg
tokens.usage: The base: cards, tables, popovers, alerts, saved-view tiles.

tokens.name: radius-xl
tokens.usage: Dialogs, the command palette, the side sheet, the inset panel, the bulk bar.

tokens.name: radius-2xl
tokens.usage: The top corners of the bottom sheet; the floating action button.

tokens.name: radius-full
tokens.usage: Switches, avatars, filter chips, phone saved-view pills.

shadow.note: Layered and faint. Containers rely on borders; only floating things get depth.

tokens.name: shadow-xs
tokens.usage: Inputs, outline buttons, the inset panel.

tokens.name: shadow-sm
tokens.usage: The active segmented tab, the switch thumb.

tokens.name: shadow-md
tokens.usage: Menus, popovers, tooltips.

tokens.name: shadow-lg
tokens.usage: Sheets, toasts, the bulk bar.

tokens.name: shadow-xl
tokens.usage: Dialogs and the command palette.

size.note: Comfortable by default. data-density="compact" swaps each *-compact value in; phones raise every touch control to touch-target.

tokens.name: control-sm
tokens.usage: Toolbar buttons, facets, row actions, pagination.

tokens.name: control-sm-compact
tokens.usage: control-sm in compact density.

tokens.name: control-md
tokens.usage: Default buttons, inputs, selects.

tokens.name: control-md-compact
tokens.usage: control-md in compact density.

tokens.name: control-lg
tokens.usage: The command palette input; the bottom-sheet action dock.

tokens.name: touch-target
tokens.usage: The minimum height of anything tapped on a phone: buttons, nav items, inputs, card rows reach at least this.

tokens.name: row-height
tokens.usage: Table rows (two-line cells fit).

tokens.name: row-height-compact
tokens.usage: Table rows in compact density.

tokens.name: card-row-min
tokens.usage: A record row in the phone card list.

tokens.name: header-height
tokens.usage: The inset panel header; 56px top bar on phones.

tokens.name: sidebar-width
tokens.usage: The expanded sidebar (desktop).

tokens.name: sidebar-width-icon
tokens.usage: The icon rail on tablets, or when collapsed.

tokens.name: drawer-width
tokens.usage: The nav drawer on phones.

tokens.name: sheet-width
tokens.usage: The side sheet (record peek) on tablet and desktop.

tokens.name: sheet-height-phone
tokens.usage: The bottom sheet on phones, of the viewport height.

tokens.name: dialog-width
tokens.usage: Dialogs; forms with two columns go to 640px.

breakpoint.note: Mobile first: styles apply upward from each width. Only the kit and the shell read breakpoints; screens declare, they do not branch.

tokens.name: bp-tablet
tokens.usage: From here: icon-rail sidebar, side sheet, tables (secondary columns hidden). Below: phone layout.

tokens.name: bp-desktop
tokens.usage: From here: the full 240px sidebar and every table column.
